title: The House That Remembered Him

protagonist.name: Nirmalendu 'Nirmal' Roy
protagonist.role: Port surveyor, husband, father, grandfather, sole keeper of 14 Balaram Ghosh Street, Shyambazar
protagonist.coreArc: A complete human life traced from childhood under British air-raid sirens to old age in an empty eight-room mansion, witnessing Kolkata's transformation and the inevitable passage of generations.

lifelongCompanion.name: Kalyani Roy
lifelongCompanion.role: Wife of 44 years; the warmth, order, and anchor of the household

setting.primary: 14 Balaram Ghosh Street, Shyambazar, North Kolkata
setting.secondary: Baghbazar Ghat; the Port Trust jetty on the Hooghly; the southern terrace roof
setting.atmosphere: Green wooden shutters, cool lime-plastered walls, tram bells clanging on Bidhan Sarani, scent of parijat flowers after rain

continuityObjects: The heavy brass key to the southern terrace gate, notched in 1956
The parijat tree planted in the inner courtyard in 1950 by Nirmal's mother
The 1928 Junghans pendulum wall clock requiring winding every Sunday at 08:00
The wooden study doorframe recording heights across four generations (1954 to 2018)
chronologicalChapters: Chapter I (1944–1956): Childhood in the Crowded Mansion — The War, The Uncles, The Tram Bells
Chapter II (1957–1967): Youth on the River — The Port Trust, The Father's Passing, The New Surveyor
Chapter III (1968–1980): The House Full of Voices — Marriage to Kalyani, Soma and Aniruddha
Chapter IV (1981–1999): The High Noon of Life — The Monsoons, Weddings, The Departure of the Young
Chapter V (2000–2016): The Quiet Rooms — Retirement, The Empty Dining Table, The Loss of Kalyani
Chapter VI (2017–2024): The Afternoon Sun — The Great-Granddaughter, The Final November, The Legacy of Stone
